title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Monster Data and Test Play

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】魔物データとテストプレイ
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Monster Data and Test Play

blocks.source: 当サイトの講座を参考に作品を完成させたという方から、連絡を頂いたのですが、ふりーむ！長編ＲＰＧ部門で銅賞受賞されたとのことです。すげえ！ 内容は転職システム採用で、序盤から自由度高めの王道ＲＰＧってな感じです。
blocks.translation: I was contacted by someone who completed their game using the guides on this site, and they told me it won a bronze prize in Freem!'s long-form RPG category. Amazing! It's a classic RPG with a job-change system and a high degree of freedom from the beginning.

blocks.source: http://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5921
blocks.translation: http://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5921

blocks.source: 何より、ここの講座がまともに役立ったということに感動です。なお、講座はネタ切れしたので凍結状態ですが、「誰でも一日で曲が作れるようになる作曲講座」とかアイデアはあるので、自分の作品が完成した後に再開予定です。
blocks.translation: Above all, I'm thrilled that the guides here were genuinely useful. The guides are currently frozen because I ran out of ideas, but I do have ideas such as a "music composition guide that lets anyone learn to make a song in one day," so I plan to resume them after completing my own game.

blocks.source: そして、僕も負けてはいられません。今年こそ作品を完成させられるようにがんばります。
blocks.translation: And I can't afford to lose, either. I'll do my best to finish my game this year.

blocks.source: ……で、自分の開発記録に戻ります。
blocks.translation: ...Anyway, back to my Development Log.

blocks.source: 装備画面では能力の上下変化を色付けして分かりやすくしました。地味な改善とはいえおこたれません。細かいことですが、何だかしっくりこないので青上昇＆赤下降に変更するかもしれません。『赤字』なんて言葉がある通り、赤にはマイナスイメージがあるので、そのほうが分かりやすい気がします。
blocks.translation: I made changes in the equipment screen easier to understand by coloring increases and decreases in abilities. Even though it's a minor improvement, I can't neglect it. It's a small detail, but it doesn't quite feel right, so I may switch to blue for increases and red for decreases. As the expression "in the red" suggests, red has a negative image, so that might be easier to understand.

blocks.source: ダンジョン内では先頭のキャラしか表示できない仕様です。しかし、寂しかったので先頭に表示されるキャラをシフトキーで交代できるようにしました。なお、何のメリットもありません。気分転換です。
blocks.translation: Only the lead character can be displayed inside dungeons. However, it felt lonely, so I made it possible to switch the character displayed in front using the Shift key. Of course, this provides no benefit whatsoever. It's just a change of pace.

blocks.source: 魔物データを設定しながら、通しでのテストプレイをしています。テストプレイといっても、色々と作りこみの甘いところがたくさんあるので、修正を入れまくりです。
blocks.translation: I'm conducting a full playtest while configuring the monster data. Even though it's a playtest, there are still many areas where the game is insufficiently polished, so I'm making corrections left and right.

blocks.source: ちょっと進んでは気になるところを見つけては修正してって具合です。大方できあがったものを調整するだけなので、大したことないだろうと高をくくっていましたが、なかなか作業量が多くて、精神力が要求されます。
blocks.translation: I make a little progress, find something that bothers me, and then fix it. I had assumed it wouldn't be a big deal since I was only adjusting something that was mostly finished, but there's actually a lot of work involved, and it requires considerable mental stamina.

blocks.source: 具体的には……
blocks.translation: Specifically...

blocks.source: 魔物能力の設定。魔物の特徴が薄いと感じた場合は、新技の追加も。
blocks.translation: Configuring monster abilities. If a monster's characteristics feel too weak, I may add new skills as well.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントの配置。シンボルが多すぎないか、少なすぎないか。
blocks.translation: Placing symbol encounters. Are there too many symbols, or too few?

blocks.source: スキルの調整。特にスキルポイントに過不足ないか？
blocks.translation: Adjusting skills. In particular, are there too many or too few skill points?

blocks.source: お金の調整。前作ダンジョンＲＰＧより金策手段が少ないので、
blocks.translation: Adjusting the amount of money. Since there are fewer ways to earn money than in the previous dungeon RPG,

blocks.source: 魔物の所持金は増量必須かも。
blocks.translation: I may need to increase the money carried by monsters.

blocks.source: その他ゲームバランスの調整。
blocks.translation: Adjusting other aspects of the game balance.

blocks.source: マップのチェック。当たり判定など。
blocks.translation: Checking the maps, including collision detection.

blocks.source: 文章のチェック。
blocks.translation: Checking the text.

blocks.source: 文章のリズムと読みやすさに、必要な情報が不足してないかも。
blocks.translation: Also checking whether the rhythm and readability of the text are good, and whether any necessary information is missing.

blocks.source: イベント演出。物足りない＆分かりにくいと思ったらテコ入れする。
blocks.translation: Event direction. If something feels lacking or difficult to understand, I will rework it.

blocks.source: バグのチェック＆修正。
blocks.translation: Checking for and fixing bugs.

blocks.source: などなどです。
blocks.translation: And so on.

blocks.source: 実プレイ時間にして、数時間程度のテストプレイを何十時間とかけて実施しました。しかし、これ序盤のストーリー的な吸引力はやや弱いかもしれませんね。ストーリーといい世界観といい、我ながらなんてベタなんだ……ってな感じです。次回があれば、真っ先に挑戦したい点ではあります。
blocks.translation: I spent dozens of hours conducting playtests that took several hours of actual playtime. However, the opening story's pull may be a little weak. The story, the world, everything feels so cliché that even I have to say, "How predictable..." If there is a next time, this is something I would want to tackle first.

blocks.source: 他の人の作品をいくらかやると、自分より若くてそんなに制作経験のなさそうな人が、よほどうまくストーリーを作ってたりするので不思議です。ストーリーって、思った以上に色んな要素が絡まってくるので、ゲームバランス以上に経験がいりそうに思うのですが……。もしや、これが才能の差というやつなのか……！？
blocks.translation: When I play some other people's games, I'm amazed to see people younger than me, and who don't seem to have much development experience, creating remarkably good stories. Stories involve more elements than I expected, so I feel they require even more experience than game balance does... Could this be what they call the difference in talent...!?

blocks.source: ……といいながら、単なる僕の経験不足のような気もします。思えば、同人ゲーとか長く作っていたせいで長編制作経験はかなりある割に、まともにオリジナルのストーリーを創作した記憶がロクにありません。あの頃はどうパロディするかしか、考えてなかったような気がします。ていうか、まっとうな直近のオリジナル作品がフライドチキン２という時点でアカン気がします。
blocks.translation: ...That said, I also feel it may simply be due to my lack of experience. Come to think of it, although I have quite a lot of experience creating long-form games from spending so long making doujin games, I can hardly remember ever properly creating an original story. Back then, I feel like all I thought about was how to parody things. In fact, considering that my most recent proper original work was Fried Chicken 2, I feel like I'm already in trouble.

blocks.source: それでも、今までの作品と比較してストーリー面の満足度は段違いです。何だかんだで中盤以降キャラが揃ってきて、船を手に入れて、自由度が上がって……てな辺りからはストーリーや冒険も面白くなるんじゃないかと思っています。当初予定より仲間のキャラが立ってきたのも収穫です。
blocks.translation: Even so, my satisfaction with the story is on a completely different level compared to my previous games. Once the party comes together around the middle of the game, I obtain a ship, and the degree of freedom increases... I think the story and adventure will become more interesting from around that point onward. Another nice outcome is that the party members have developed stronger personalities than originally planned.

blocks.source: それまでは、ゲームシステムやドット絵やその他諸々の雰囲気で、何とかプレイヤーのモチベを持続させるって感じでいきましょう。
blocks.translation: Until then, let's keep the players motivated with the game systems, pixel art, and the overall atmosphere created by everything else.

blocks.source: てなわけで７００時間消化です。
blocks.translation: And with that, I've used up 700 hours.
